display_long_description:
**The ground-breaking new title from nDreams Elevation – the VR-immersion expert’s pioneering new studio.**

Embody a reluctant hero, wield extraordinary abilities, and journey into a perilous world of crossed realities. Are you ready to make the leap?  

[media]

**Live the adventure**

Delve deep into a spectacular world packed with mythical threats, and secrets to uncover. 

[media]

**Own the action**

Freely jump, climb, and zip-line across breathtaking environments with smooth, intuitive traversal designed for VR. 

[media]

**Unrivalled immersion**

Full-body awareness and true-to-life interactions deliver unmatched presence in every moment. 

[media]

**Purchase the Deluxe Upgrade at launch to receive the Ferran (dark) and Agent cosmetic sets.**
[media]

Deluxe Edition content, including the artbook and soundtrack, will be accessible in-game.
